# A far islet on the horizon: a low faceted hill and a striped lighthouse with a lit lamp.
# Origin at the water line under the hill. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Hill --base-color 0.671 0.337 0.459 --no-slot
material new Tower --base-color 1.000 0.906 0.839 --no-slot
material new Stripe --base-color 0.933 0.416 0.486 --no-slot
material new Lamp --base-color 1.000 0.878 0.494 --no-slot --emission 1.000 0.878 0.494
add mesh cone --name Hill --vertices 7 --radius1 2.4 --radius2 0.6 --depth 1.0 --location 0 0 0.3
scale 1 0.5 1
apply --scale
material assign Hill
add mesh cone --name Tower --vertices 6 --radius1 0.32 --radius2 0.22 --depth 1.6 --location 0.4 0 1.6
material assign Tower
add mesh cylinder --name Band --vertices 6 --radius 0.3 --depth 0.25 --location 0.4 0 1.5
material assign Stripe
add mesh cube --name Lamp --size 0.3 --location 0.4 0 2.52
material assign Lamp
add mesh cone --name Cap --vertices 6 --radius1 0.28 --radius2 0 --depth 0.3 --location 0.4 0 2.8
material assign Stripe
select all
shade flat
export island.glb
